rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for money paid or spent as an expense.

example.english: This expense has to be paid immediately.
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 fai3 jung6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 bei2

rows.note: Use this for an amount or pattern of spending, especially in a household or budget, rather than a particular fee.

example.english: We need to keep a close eye on our household expense every month.
example.traditional: 我哋要睇實每個月嘅屋企開支。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 sat6 mui5 go3 jyut6 ge3 uk1 kei2 hoi1 zi1
